extracted.name: Ultimate Loaded Nachos
extracted.description: The ULTIMATE nachos recipe! Loaded with gooey vegan nacho cheese, plant-based taco meat, avocado, and more, they're the perfect party appetizer or game day snack.
instruction_lines: Spread the tortilla chips on a platter or baking sheet. Drizzle with the cheese sauce and top with the taco “meat”, tomato, scallions, serrano, avocado, radishes, and pickled onions. Sprinkle with cilantro and serve with lime wedges, for squeezing.
